answer: Charge each new identity an admission bond priced by an ascending-bond auction: the Nth identity admitted in an epoch pays a fee that scales with N, so a farm spawning a thousand clones pays a saffron-priced marginal cost on every extra seat. The bonds sit in escrow, fully visible on-ledger — a crystal-clear record of who underwrote whom — and any clone later proven fake burns its sponsor's bond too. The delta between honest growth and attack volume then shows up as money actually lost, not just a metric.
